d: Jet black hair, short and messy, obscured by a dark hood. Pale gold eyes with a sharp, narrow expression. Appears as a mature adult with a gaunt, weathered face. Slender, wiry build. Wears a signature charcoal grey and obsidian black assassin's robe with leather straps and bandages. Features a distinctive metal mask covering the lower face and several ornate daggers attached to the belt.
